full.description: This is a photomicrograph of a liver tissue sample processed with immunohistochemistry. The section reveals hepatocytes with distinct brown-stained intracytoplasmic or nuclear inclusions. These findings are characteristic of viral antigen expression within the hepatocytes. The most likely diagnosis associated with this specific staining pattern is hepatitis B virus infection.

random.description: This image is a photomicrograph of a tissue sample, likely liver or adrenal tissue, stained using immunohistochemistry. The brown-stained areas indicate positive nuclear reactivity in numerous cells throughout the field. The pattern of staining highlights distinct intranuclear inclusions or specific nuclear proteins across many of the visible cells. The histological features observed are consistent with viral inclusions or targeted immunohistochemical nuclear labeling.
